pages.text: Fish at night under a full moon in water at least 30 blocks deep. A catch has a 50% chance to grant the Call and 5 seconds of Unnamable.

pages.title: Offering
pages.text: Smelting one yields 1000 mB of molten ink for $(l:material_ashen_ink)Ashen Ink$().$(br2)Save one instead of smelting it if you want to challenge Momo. Finish eating it at the center of an End $(l:starwell_arena)Starwell Arena$().
